# Allternit

> Allternit is an AI-native operations platform: an agent runtime with a native
> tool belt, MCP connectors, computer-use automation (ACI), SDKs, CLI, and
> self-hosting options. This file lists the public documentation set for LLM
> crawlers and AI assistants.

## Computer use (ACI)

- [ACI overview](docs/public/aci/index.md): What the Allternit Computer Interface is, and how self-hosted ACI compares to managed cloud sandboxes.
- [ACI quickstart](docs/public/aci/quickstart.md): Run your first browser automation in one API call; stream run events over SSE.
- [ACI guide](docs/public/aci/guide.md): Integration modes (intent-driven runs, direct computer control, capability path), action space and tool versions (20250124/20251124), approvals and server-side enforcement, environments and the VM driver, recording and replay, monitoring.
- [ACI recipes](docs/public/aci/recipes.md): Copy-paste flows — drive a browser, replay a run's event history, approve a risky action.
- [ACI tool contract changelog](docs/public/aci/changelog.md): Version history for the Allternit Computer Use tool contract.

## Tools and MCP

- [Native Tool Belt](docs/public/tools/tool-belt.md): Built-in tools — web_search, web_fetch, bash, code_execution, memory, str_replace_editor, computer.
- [MCP](docs/public/tools/mcp.md): Attaching MCP servers, server-side execution, bundled/remote directory pattern, tunnel security.
- [Strict tool use](docs/public/tools/strict-tool-use.md): JSON Schema validation and grammar-constrained tool inputs.
